data_explorer

Provides functions or classes for exploring analysis data.

Classes

DataExplorerApp(master)

A GUI application to scan analysis files for sections meeting specific feature criteria.
class data_explorer.DataExplorerApp(master)[source]

Bases: object

A GUI application to scan analysis files for sections meeting specific feature criteria. Calculates HMM features on-the-fly during scan.

__init__(master)[source]

Initializes the DataExplorerApp GUI.

Parameters:

master (tk.Tk or tk.Toplevel) – The root window or top-level widget.

create_widgets()[source]

Creates and lays out all the GUI widgets for the application.

select_folder()[source]

Opens a dialog to select the folder containing analysis files.

Sets the folder path, updates the status bar, triggers feature/label extraction, and enables the scan button upon successful selection.

extract_features_and_labels()[source]

Loads the first valid joblib file, runs extract_section_features on it, and populates the feature and label lists available for selection in the GUI.

Updates the feature and label comboboxes and the status bar.

run_scan()[source]

Scans files in the selected folder based on user criteria.

Loads each analysis file, runs feature extraction, checks sections matching the selected label and feature condition, and displays results in the treeview.
